hazards.deleteConfirm: This hazard has {{count}} linked edge(s). Delete anyway?
hazards.noHazardsHint: Use Quick add above or “Add Hazard” to start the Bowtie.
hazards.quickAddPlaceholder: Quick add: hazard label, then Enter…

tip.id: External reference (or internal ID). Hover a cell for the internal ID.
tip.label: Short hazard label. Hover a cell for the full description.
tip.combination: How causes combine: ANY = one suffices, ALL = all required.
tip.causes: Contributing assets (causes). Hover a chip for the full name.
tip.targets: Endangered assets/persons (targets). Hover a chip for the full name.
tip.source: How the hazard entered the model: manual, imported or derived.
tip.assetUnresolved: Asset not found — showing ID only

logic.ANY: ANY single cause can realise the hazard.
logic.ALL: ALL causes must coincide to realise the hazard.

config.title: Hazard Settings
config.combinationHint: ANY: each cause alone triggers the hazard. ALL: only all contributions together arm it.
config.requireTypeHint: When on, the Bowtie blocks saving a hazard without a type.
config.maxHopsHint: Reserved for the upcoming safety derivation across asset-to-asset hops. No effect yet.

dialog.label: Hazard label
dialog.noCauses: At least one contributing asset is required.
dialog.noTargets: At least one protection target is required.

import.title: Import mapping
import.bannerIdle: Select a field (or an extra column) on the left, then click a column header in the grid.
import.bannerSingle: Click a column header to map it to “{{field}}”.
import.bannerMatrix: Matrix mode: click the level columns for “{{field}}”, then set each column’s value.
import.bannerMeta: Click a column header to store it as provenance under “{{key}}”.

tooltips.field: Click to make this the active mapping target, then click a column header.
tooltips.mode: Single = one column. Matrix = several “x”-marked columns, one per level.
tooltips.addExtra: Keep an extra source column as provenance (importMeta)
tooltips.headerRow: Row that holds the column titles (hint only).
tooltips.dataStartRow: First row that contains hazard data.
tooltips.idFilter: Optional regex on the id column; non-matching rows are skipped.

review.scopeQuestion: Is this hazard reachable by a cyberattack?
review.scopeHint: In scope → model the bowtie. Out of scope → kept in the safety record but excluded from threat generation.
review.bowtieGated: Decide system scope to enable the bowtie.
review.bowtieOut: Out of scope — no cyber cause/target modeling needed.

scopeTip.in_scope: In scope — reachable by a cyberattack
scopeTip.out_of_scope: Out of scope — not cyber-caused; excluded from threat analysis
